en.title: 26 U.S.C. §42(j)(5)(C)(i) refers to “subparagraph (B)(i)”, which has had no clauses since 1988
en.summary: Section 42(j)(5)(C)(i) treats a husband and wife as one partner “for purposes of subparagraph (B)(i)”. Subparagraph (B) is a single sentence about partnerships with 35 or more partners and has had no clauses since P.L. 100-647 §4004(a) rewrote it.

quotes.source: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, United States Code, Title 26, release point 119-121 (XML)
quotes.text: For purposes of subparagraph (B)(i), a husband and wife (and their estates) shall be treated as 1 partner.

quotes.source: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, United States Code, Title 26, release point 119-121 (XML)
quotes.text: (B) Partnerships to which paragraph applies This paragraph shall apply to any partnership which has 35 or more partners unless the partnership elects not to have this paragraph apply.

summary.en: In release point 119-134 of the United States Code, the reference carries a footnote mark and a References in Text note: subparagraph (B) has contained no clauses since its 1988 amendment. The wording of the section is unchanged.

document.title: Office of the Law Revision Counsel: United States Code, release point 119-134, 26 U.S.C. §42

responses.before: For purposes of subparagraph (B)(i), a husband and wife (and their estates) shall be treated as 1 partner.
responses.after: For purposes of subparagraph (B)(i),¹ a husband and wife (and their estates) shall be treated as 1 partner. References in Text note: “Subparagraph (B), referred to in subsec. (j)(5)(C)(i), meaning subsec. (j)(5)(B) of this section, was amended generally by Pub. L. 100-647, title IV, § 4004(a), Nov. 10, 1988, 102 Stat. 3644, and, as so amended, no longer contains clauses. For text of subsec. (j)(5)(B) prior to amendment, see 1988 Amendment note below.”
